description: This file defines a data structure for buffer protection metadata related to media encryption and a function to process such metadata, specifically in the context of GStreamer multimedia framework.

classes.name: BufferProtectionMetadata
classes.description: A structure holding metadata related to encrypted media buffers, including encryption status, key IDs, initialization vectors, subsample information, and encryption scheme details.

methods.name: ProcessProtectionMetadata
methods.description: A function that processes a GStreamer buffer to extract and populate BufferProtectionMetadata information.
